resources.string: Use valid text within %1$d UTF-8 bytes. The previous draft has been retained.
Choose an existing conversation from your PC. Its history and work stay on that PC.
Create, rename, archive and pin chats. Archive keeps chat history; permanent deletion is not supported.
Could not read or save appearance preferences. Try selecting the theme again.
Resume to reconnect to your linked PC. Your draft stays on this phone only while the app process lives. Nothing is sent while paused.
The phone connects only while this app is visible. Leaving it stops the connection and discards invitations. Drafts are kept only in memory. Nothing is queued offline or resent automatically.
Account controls require PC support that this companion protocol does not provide. Manage accounts in Harnessy on your PC; no provider keys are stored here.
With matching PC support and model permission enabled for this phone, choose a model in the composer of an active, idle chat. Account settings, global defaults and usage reporting stay on your PC.
Background notifications are not configured. Push setup and additional PC support are required. Keep this app visible to receive live progress.
History formats approved text with native Markdown and code blocks. HTML remains literal; links and image addresses are text only. No content executes or opens automatically.
Searches conversations loaded from your PC
This conversation is closed on your PC.
What is available on this phone
Could not refresh this conversation. Previously loaded text is still shown.
Choose a conversation in the sidebar.
Tool arguments, result bodies and per-tool timing are not supplied to this phone.
Could not save the folder’s open/closed state. Tap the folder to try again.
Workspace and activity details require the updated PC app.
The PC refused this chat change. Refresh the sidebar and check the chat on your PC before trying again.
Change result unknown. The PC may have applied this change. Check the named chat on your PC before making another change. Nothing is resent automatically.

The PC may have applied the previous chat change even if its reply was lost. Clear only this warning after checking the named chat on your PC. This does not retry, undo or cancel that change. Any new action is a new request.
Live model switching needs matching PC companion support. This Android-only update does not change your PC.
Enable model selection for this phone in Harnessy on your PC.
Wait for this chat to finish its current work before changing the model.
Open a live chat on your PC to change its model.
Could not load models from your PC.
No models are available from your PC.
The model change was refused. Refresh models and check the chat on your PC before trying again.
Model change result unknown. Check this chat on your PC before changing its model or sending another message. Nothing is resent automatically.
After checking the chat on your PC, clear only this warning. This does not retry or undo a model change.
Enable opening existing chats for this phone in your PC’s Phone settings. Model selection remains a separate permission.
No desktop chat tab is needed. Opening keeps history and does not send your draft.
PC access could not be confirmed. Update the PC first, then check again.
Keep the PC awake and Harnessy running, then reconnect to open this chat.
The PC did not open this chat. Check permission and refresh its status before trying again.
The chat opening result is unknown. Check this chat’s current PC state before reviewing this warning. Nothing will be reopened automatically.
I checked this chat’s PC state
Too many chats have unsent drafts. Clear one draft before starting another. Existing drafts were retained.
